::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 6th 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mary Yonge Fellowship
:::

Dear [Miss Cole](people/person_326.qmd)[^1]				
I am much obliged for your book which I am sure I shall read with much interest as the fruit of so many thoughts

I hear from [Mrs Montgomery Moore](people/person_1042.qmd) from [Rawal Pindee](organizations/other_262.qmd)which at least is near that beautiful Cashmere though she never will be happy in India.

[Elizabeth](people/person_320.qmd) is at Dittisham[^2]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Another letter exists, evidently to the same Miss Cole who was a friend of the Colborne family, dated 17 March [1860s?].  On the evidence of this letter, she may have been Nina Cole, author of *Meditations on the Song of Songs* (1874), a volume edited by the Rev. George Cosby White.
[^2]: The Rector of Dittisham was the Rev. and Hon. Graham Colborne, brother of Jane Montgomery Moore and Elizabeth Colborne.
